representativeOrder.scenario: Standard×3, no promo, User C logs in mid-cart via top-right popup

cartPersistence.probeBeforeLogin: Probe: document.getElementById('ticket-quantity-dropdown').value (also body $ scan). Result BEFORE login: standardQty='3', cart subtotal visible (prices $50.00 x repeats). Standard card was in quantity-widget mode with qty=3.
cartPersistence.probeAfterLogin: Probe: same dropdown value + #gp-test-proceed-to-checkout visibility + visible #add-item count. Result AFTER login: standardQty='3', visibleAddItem=1, visibleAdd=3 (Standard still converted, other 3 cards still have ADD), gp-test-proceed-to-checkout visible. Cart is unchanged — same 3 Standard tickets. No re-add needed.
cartPersistence.notes: Key finding: Bubble's login popup does NOT clear the anonymous cart. The runner sequencer can SAFELY add tickets first, then log in mid-cart, without re-adding after login. The Login link (id=gp-test-login-link) is replaced with a Logout link after successful authentication (confirmed via gp-test-login-link.offsetParent === null post-login).

steps.businessName: click Tickets button on landing view
steps.notes: Shared with guest-checkout flow. URL becomes ?tab=tickets. Per Gotchas Registry '### Login flow: Login link only appears inside the tickets view' — the top-right Login link is NOT on the landing view and only appears after this click.

steps.businessName: click ADD on the Standard ticket card (1st time — transitions card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: Shared ID '#add' across all 4 ticket cards. Pick visible idx=0 (Standard) per '### Bubble shared IDs: #add and #add-item disambiguated by visibility + DOM order'.

steps.businessName: set Standard ticket quantity to 3 via #ticket-quantity-dropdown (native setter + change event)
steps.notes: After the initial ADD click the quantity dropdown was observed to read '4' (not 1) on this capture — seems to have auto-advanced. Rather than rely on '#add-item' click counts (which exist but are subject to the same Bubble input-event quirks), the discovery agent drove the dropdown directly with the native-setter+input+change pattern from '### Bubble input: el.value = x does not register'. An alternative kept for the sequencer: use clickVisibleByIdIndex('#add-item', 0) N-1 times to take qty 1→N. Either approach needs a fresh qty verification via the dropdown.value before proceeding.

steps.businessName: cart-state PROBE BEFORE login — capture Standard qty and PROCEED visibility
steps.notes: eval: { standardQty: document.getElementById('ticket-quantity-dropdown').value, hasProceed: !!#gp-test-proceed-to-checkout (visible) }. Result: { standardQty: '3', hasProceed: true }. Recorded in cartPersistence.probeBeforeLogin above.

steps.businessName: click the top-right Login link in the tickets-view header
steps.notes: The Login link is an H4 heading with its own ID — clicking it opens the Log In popup without any redirect or new tab. Per '### Browser session: never open new tabs, never navigate to separate login pages' this is the ONLY correct way to reach the login form from the tickets view.

steps.businessName: wait for Log In popup (heading 'Log in')
steps.notes: Anchor: heading 'Log in' [level=2]. Popup also exposes 'SIGN UP' button, Email + Password inputs, and a 'Reset Password' link. Neither the popup container, its heading, nor any of its form controls has a stable ID attribute — see missingIdsOnStep1.

steps.businessName: fill popup Email field with User C email
steps.notes: No id. Selector: input[type=email][placeholder="Email"]. Use '### Bubble input: el.value = x does not register' pattern — native value setter + input+change events. Class hash 'cnxpg1' might drift on republish; placeholder+type is the stable combo.

steps.businessName: fill popup Password field with User C password
steps.notes: No id. Selector: input[type=password][placeholder="Password"]. Same native-setter pattern as email field.

steps.businessName: click LOG IN button in popup
steps.notes: No id. Selector: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.offsetParent !== null && b.textContent.trim() === 'LOG IN'). Wait ~2-3s for popup to close; post-login signal is gp-test-login-link disappearing (offsetParent === null) and a 'Logout' link appearing in the header.

steps.businessName: cart-state PROBE AFTER login — verify persistence
steps.notes: Same probe as step 4. Result: { standardQty: '3', hasProceed: true, visibleAdd: 3, visibleAddItem: 1 }. CART PERSISTED — no re-add. Recorded in cartPersistence.probeAfterLogin above. The tickets-view cart does NOT roundtrip to the server at login; it is local to the session and survives the popup auth flow.

steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cnpqaZ0 bubble-r-container relative
steps.notes: Same primitive as guest-checkout. Transitions to Step 1; wait for #main-full-name visible.

steps.businessName: verify Step 1 contact fields are pre-filled from User C profile
steps.notes: Observed values: main-full-name = 'GP E2E Order 16', main-email = 'abhjoseph+userc@gmail.com'. Both are pre-populated from User C's saved profile. Per task spec, when pre-filled leave as-is — do NOT overwrite. When a logged-in user's profile lacks these fields (e.g. a freshly-registered user), fall back to the native-setter pattern and fill 'GP Disc TopRight' / User C email.

steps.businessName: check 'contact info is same for all tickets' checkbox on Step 1
steps.text: The contact information is the same for all tickets
steps.notes: Shared with guest-checkout. After checking, per-ticket fields auto-fill from Contact Info.

steps.businessName: check the 'authorized cardholder' consent checkbox at bottom of Step 1
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cpmaJo1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: I am the authorized cardholder for this purchase...
steps.notes: Still no id — see '### Bubble Step-1: authorized cardholder checkbox has no ID'. Selector: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.clickable-element.bubble-element.Group')).find(e => e.textContent.includes('authorized cardholder')).

steps.businessName: click CONTINUE on Step 1 (logged-in exit button)
steps.notes: KEY DIFFERENCE FROM guest-checkout: the logged-in Step 1 exit button is '#continue-registered-user' (label 'CONTINUE'), NOT '#continue-as-guest' (label 'CONTINUE AS GUEST'). The guest-button ID is absent in this flow. Transitions to Step 2; wait for #toggle-terms + #complete-order-authnet visible.

steps.businessName: probe Step 2 payment panel — saved card vs Add Payment Method
steps.notes: Observed on this run: User C has a SAVED CARD already (displayed as '**** **** **** 0027', Exp Date 2027-04). No '+ Add Payment Method' button is rendered. Radio 'Card' is pre-checked. PAY NOW is enabled once #toggle-terms is ON. If a future run of this flow exercises a freshly-created User C with no saved card, the runner must branch into the Authorize.net Add-Payment-Method detour per '### Authorize.net: Add Payment Method detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user' — click '+ Add Payment Method', fill card with pressSequentially, click SAVE, then re-toggle terms and click PAY NOW a second time.

steps.businessName: toggle the Terms & Conditions ionic toggle on Step 2
steps.notes: Per '### Bubble ionic-toggle: outer div click silently no-ops — click inner <label>', click document.getElementById('toggle-terms').querySelector('label'). Verify #toggle-terms input[type=checkbox].checked === true before clicking PAY NOW.

steps.businessName: click PAY NOW on Step 2 — completes directly (saved card, no Authorize.net redirect)
steps.notes: Because User C has a saved card, clicking PAY NOW does NOT redirect to test.authorize.net. The checkout completes server-side and the same page re-renders with the 'Order Confirmed' heading. Observed: 'Order Confirmed' heading appeared within ~3-5s, URL remained /event/...?tab=tickets (no success=yes query appended in this template — key on the heading text, not the URL, for this flow). Contrast with guest-checkout where the order goes through Authorize.net's hosted form.

steps.businessName: wait for success — heading 'Order Confirmed' visible
steps.notes: Success signal is the 'Order Confirmed' heading. Per '### Authorize.net: post-return success heading is too brief — key on the URL query', we normally OR the heading with a success=yes query check. For this logged-in-with-saved-card branch the heading DID persist long enough to be polled deterministically (no redirect roundtrip, so no URL-flag race). Keep the OR for safety.

newGotchas.symptom: Sequencer design question: if the anonymous cart is cleared at login, the guest-to-login-top-right flow has to be reversed (login first, THEN add tickets).
newGotchas.cause: Unknown — depends on whether Bubble's session storage is re-keyed on authentication.
newGotchas.fix: VERIFIED on 2026-04-23: the cart PERSISTS through the top-right login popup. 3 Standard tickets added as guest remained in the cart post-login, quantity dropdown value unchanged, PROCEED TO CHECKOUT still visible. No cart migration needed. Sequencer can keep the natural order: land → Tickets → add Std×3 as guest → Login top-right → popup → LOG IN → PROCEED TO CHECKOUT. If this ever changes on a future republish, the probe-before/probe-after dropdown comparison in this discovery will flag it immediately.

newGotchas.symptom: Sequencer primitives built for guest-checkout look for '#continue-as-guest' on Step 1, but in the logged-in branch that id does not exist.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble renders a different button when the user is authenticated: '#continue-registered-user' with label 'CONTINUE'. '#continue-as-guest' is conditionally hidden for logged-in users.
newGotchas.fix: In fragmentStep1Consent (or equivalent primitive) branch on login state: if the user is logged in, click '#continue-registered-user'; otherwise click '#continue-as-guest'. Waiting on BOTH ids makes the primitive mode-agnostic: pwEval(() => ({ loggedIn: !!document.getElementById('continue-registered-user'), guest: !!document.getElementById('continue-as-guest') })).

newGotchas.symptom: PAY NOW on a logged-in user with a saved card does NOT redirect to Authorize.net — the order completes in-place.
newGotchas.cause: When a Customer Payment Profile exists, Bubble's backend charges it server-side via a direct Authorize.net API call rather than using the hosted payment page.
newGotchas.fix: The waitForSuccess primitive must tolerate both paths: (a) redirect-and-return (guest and first-order-logged-in with Add-Payment-Method detour), and (b) in-place completion (saved-card logged-in). Both land on the same 'Order Confirmed' heading, but (b) never has a success=yes query appended in this event template. The existing URL-OR-heading wait pattern already covers this — just make sure Authorize.net navigation is NOT required for success in this flow's runner branch.

newGotchas.symptom: Clicking '#add' on a ticket card one time did NOT leave the quantity at 1 — the dropdown read '4' after a single ADD click on this event template.
newGotchas.cause: Unclear — may be stale state from a prior probe, or the event's ticket-card component auto-advances qty on mount. Needs verification on a clean re-open.
newGotchas.fix: Rather than relying on click-count accounting, drive the quantity directly via '#ticket-quantity-dropdown' with the native setter + input+change event pattern. Cheap, deterministic, and matches the spec for each order without exercising the ADD/+ counter semantics.
newGotchas.source: Order #16 discovery, 2026-04-23. Flagged for re-validation during the logged-in-checkout discovery pass, which will also exercise this widget.
